product.ta-10-4.summary: The TA 10/4 stored accounting data on magnetic ledger cards.
product.ta-10-4.history: Triumph-Adler designed it for magnetic-card accounting. The 1975 programming supplement documents the KAN 2 configuration.
product.ta-10-4.technical.configuration: Two PROM modules could hold 1024 program words. The manual assigns words 1–512 to the right module and 513–1024 to the left.
product.ta-10-4.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-10-4.technical.limitations: The program from an identified unit and an operating test remain pending.
